_comment: Test data for ISchemaGraphProvider. Deserializes into SchemaGraphData (Providers/ISchemaGraphProvider.cs). Mirrors Python GraphConfig.json structure.

Entities.Name: Incident
Entities.Description: A customer-reported support incident (ICM ticket). Central entity linking customers, services, and resolution workflows.

Entities.Name: Customer
Entities.Description: A customer with one or more Azure subscriptions.

Entities.Name: Recommendation
Entities.Description: A linked recommendation associated with an incident, tracking ACM recommendations and their approval status.

Entities.Name: SupportTicket
Entities.Description: A support request ticket with case details, topic, state, and severity information. Linked to incidents via SearchSRsByICMId function. When user asks for 'related incidents' or 'linked incidents' to an ICM, this means support tickets.

Entities.Name: RecommendationType
Entities.Description: Reference data for recommendation types with categories, impacts, and metadata. Joined with LinkedRecommendations to get descriptive fields.

Relationships.CompletenessNote: Obtained via SearchSRsByICMId function and joined to ObserveCustomerModel
Obtained via SearchSRsByICMId function. ICMId is parent incident, IncidentId is child incident linked to SR.

Tables.Description: Table for recommendations linked to incidents with ACM tracking and approval status. Filter by IncidentId directly (ICM ID = IncidentId).

Reference table containing recommendation type definitions with categories, impacts, and metadata. IMPORTANT: This table is on a different cluster - use cluster() annotation for cross-cluster queries.
Customer observation model with S500 status and customer details for enterprise customers.

Functions.Name: SearchSRsByICMId
Functions.Description: Returns The SRs linked with the ICM with L2 aggregation. Output includes Customers array with CustomerName and CustomerType.

Parameters.Name: IcmIds
Parameters.Description: List of ICM IDs to search for (e.g., dynamic(['737636804']))

Transformations.Reason: Customers is a dynamic array that must be expanded to get individual customer rows
Transformations.WhenRequired: ONLY when query FILTERS on Customer fields (S500, CustomerType, CustomerName) or JOINS to customer tables (ObserveCustomerModel). For ticket-only queries (list/count SupportRequestNumber), do NOT expand - just project SupportTicket.* columns directly.
Transformations.ExtendGuidance: ALWAYS extract ALL fields you will filter on. If filtering on CustomerType (e.g., 'Enterprise'), you MUST include CustomerType in extend. Common pattern: | mv-expand todynamic(Customers) | extend CustomerName = tostring(Customers.CustomerName), CustomerType = tostring(Customers.CustomerType) | where CustomerType == 'Enterprise'
Transformations.DistinctGuidance: After filtering, use distinct to remove duplicate rows before joining: | distinct ParentIncidentId = ICMId, IncidentId, CustomerName

Customer.Name.Note: Array of objects with CustomerName and CustomerType. Use mv-expand Customers to flatten.

QueryRules.Name: KqlJoinSyntax
QueryRules.Description: When joining on columns with different names, rename the column in the inner table using project. Wrap cross-database tables in parentheses.
QueryRules.Example: | join kind=inner (database('customerdomdata').ObserveCustomerModel | project CustomerName = MSCustomerName, S500) on CustomerName
QueryRules.Important: KQL join 'on' clause requires matching column names. Rename columns in the inner query using project.

QueryRules.Name: MvExpandExtract
QueryRules.Description: After mv-expand on a bag column, you must extend to extract ALL fields you'll filter or join on
QueryRules.Example: | mv-expand todynamic(Customers) | extend CustomerName = tostring(Customers.CustomerName), CustomerType = tostring(Customers.CustomerType)
QueryRules.Important: Extract ALL fields needed for filtering or joining in the same extend statement. Use todynamic() with mv-expand for explicit type handling. If filtering on CustomerType, you MUST extend it first.

QueryRules.Name: KqlSummarizeSyntax
QueryRules.Description: KQL summarize uses assignment syntax, NOT 'as' keyword
QueryRules.Important: CORRECT: summarize MyCount = count(). WRONG: summarize count() as MyCount

QueryRules.Name: MultiPartQuestions
QueryRules.Description: When user asks multiple questions (detected by multiple '?' or 'and' conjunctions), generate separate numbered queries for each part

QueryRules.Name: S500CustomerFilter
QueryRules.Description: To filter S500 customers: 1) mv-expand Customers, 2) extend CustomerName AND CustomerType from bag, 3) optionally filter CustomerType, 4) use distinct before join, 5) join to ObserveCustomerModel WITH S500 filter INSIDE the join subquery
QueryRules.JoinPattern: | mv-expand todynamic(Customers) | extend CustomerName = tostring(Customers.CustomerName), CustomerType = tostring(Customers.CustomerType) | where CustomerType == 'Enterprise' | distinct ParentIncidentId = ICMId, IncidentId, CustomerName | join kind=inner (database('customerdomdata').ObserveCustomerModel | where S500 == 'Yes' | project CustomerName = MSCustomerName, S500) on CustomerName | distinct CustomerName
QueryRules.Important: Place filters INSIDE join subquery for performance. Use distinct before joins to reduce data volume and after joins to get unique results.

QueryRules.Name: DistinctBeforeAggregate
QueryRules.Description: When counting unique entities after joins or mv-expand, use distinct before summarize to avoid counting duplicates
QueryRules.Important: Without distinct, count() will include duplicates from joins and expansions. Always use distinct on the entity being counted BEFORE summarize.

QueryRules.Name: FilterPlacementInJoins
QueryRules.Description: Place filters on the inner table INSIDE the join subquery, not after the join. This improves performance and ensures correct semantics.
QueryRules.CorrectExample: | join kind=inner (database('customerdomdata').ObserveCustomerModel | where S500 == 'Yes' | project CustomerName = MSCustomerName, S500) on CustomerName
QueryRules.WrongExample: | join kind=inner (database('customerdomdata').ObserveCustomerModel | project CustomerName = MSCustomerName, S500) on CustomerName | where S500 == 'Yes'
QueryRules.Important: Filtering inside reduces data before join. Filtering outside may produce wrong results if outer table has matching rows with different filter values.

QueryRules.Name: CrossClusterJoin
QueryRules.Description: When joining tables from different clusters, use cluster() annotation for the remote table
QueryRules.Example: | join kind=inner (cluster('recommendrptwus3test.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('recommenddata').ExternalRecommendationTypes | project RecommendationTypeId, Label, Description) on RecommendationTypeId
QueryRules.Important: Tables with CrossCluster=true MUST use cluster() annotation. Check the CrossClusterAnnotation field for the exact syntax.

QueryRules.Name: RecommendationsFromIncident
QueryRules.Description: To get recommendations for an ICM/incident, query LinkedRecommendations filtered by IncidentId, then join to ExternalRecommendationTypes using cross-cluster annotation
